serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Hello Leonardo, I would like to visit, uh… {{wi}}my friend.
Concierge Leonardo: Of course, let me call his room. Please wait a second.
You: Sure…
Concierge Leonardo: I’m really sorry sir, but your friend is busy right now. He’s very sorry but he cannot let you in.
You: Oh, ok. It’s not a problem…
I wonder what Big Daddy is doing. Probably just too tired.
